Filed from P6-125 (2026-08-11). Dialog now traps Tab (overlay-stack-gated); Popover deliberately does not — a picker popover open on top of a trapped dialog keeps its own untrapped Tab order, so Tab can walk from popover content into the page. Same mechanism as dialog.rs's trap applies (share the helper), gated the same overlay-stack way; the delete confirm's disposition pickers are the live consumers. Specs: specs/ui-components.md. EXTENDED (P6-125 review, 2026-08-11) — focus-trap hardening for the shared mechanism when built: (a) TABBABLE_SELECTOR omits contenteditable/iframe/audio-video[controls]/summary/area[href]; (b) positive tabindex ordering ignored (DOM order used); (c) the offsetWidth/Height filter misses visibility:hidden — focus() on one is a no-op, stranding a wrap; (d) the zero-tabbables branch swallows Tab unconditionally — one show_close_button=false empty dialog away from a dead Tab key. None reachable with current consumers.

Added 2026-08-13 (P6-149): quick-add is the remaining overlay-stack absentee — it's deliberately not Dialog/Popover-based and its open signal is private to QuickAddPanel, so the K chord still stacks the palette over an open quick-add panel (the tree dialogs are now gated via the stack). Joining the stack (or exposing open via context) closes the last stacking path.
